description: This file defines a responsive grid layout component in React with TypeScript, including its props, internal configuration, and utility functions. It provides customizable grid variants, column configurations, gaps, and responsive behavior for layout management in UI projects.

methods.name: BaseResponsiveGrid
methods.description: Main React component that renders a customizable responsive grid container with configurable properties like variant, columns, gap, flow, and alignment.

methods.name: ResponsiveGridItem
methods.description: React component representing an individual grid item that can span multiple columns at different breakpoints.
